note: Curated project/portfolio candidates drawn from the internal 440-question bank. Reference only: not a claim of official recognition readiness, and never a CII mark.

items.question: What community problem does each initiative address?
items.minimumData: Project ID; location; problem statement; affected population
items.answerRule: Specific need rather than an SDG label alone

items.question: What evidence establishes the need?
items.minimumData: Needs assessment; source date; community consultation; baseline
items.answerRule: Evidence quality and recency

items.question: Who identified and prioritized the problem?
items.minimumData: Community representatives; selection method; consultation dates
items.answerRule: Community-defined versus university-defined needs

items.question: Who is intended to benefit?
items.minimumData: Eligibility; target population; geography; barriers; planned reach
items.answerRule: Defined target denominator and inclusion criteria

items.question: What change is the initiative intended to produce?
items.minimumData: Theory of change; inputs; outputs; outcomes; assumptions
items.answerRule: Explicit causal pathway; assumptions separately recorded

items.question: What are the project's measurable objectives?
items.minimumData: Indicator; baseline; target; deadline; measurement source
items.answerRule: Target register with unique indicator IDs

items.question: Which SDG targets are substantively relevant?
items.minimumData: SDG goal; target code; rationale; evidence; reviewer
items.answerRule: Many-to-many mapping; do not infer impact from tagging

items.question: How will benefits continue after the project ends?
items.minimumData: Handover; local capacity; maintenance; funding; responsible partner
items.answerRule: Sustainability plan and post-exit follow-up

items.question: How many students participate in community engagement?
items.minimumData: Pseudonymous student ID; activity ID; dates; approval
items.answerRule: Distinct active students; sum of event attendance is separate

items.question: How much verified service time is contributed?
items.minimumData: Person; event; start/end; breaks; verifier; approved hours
items.answerRule: Sum nonoverlapping approved hours

items.question: How many activities are student-led?
items.minimumData: Student role; decision authority; design/delivery responsibility
items.answerRule: Substantive leadership criteria; not attendance alone

items.question: How many unique community members receive services?
items.minimumData: Pseudonymous beneficiary ID; project; service date
items.answerRule: Distinct people within stated scope; document deduplication limits

items.question: How many service encounters are delivered?
items.minimumData: Encounter ID; beneficiary ID; service type; date
items.answerRule: Count encounters separately from unique beneficiaries

items.question: How many households benefit?
items.minimumData: Household ID; member linkage; eligibility
items.answerRule: Distinct households; do not treat household estimates as measured people

items.question: How many people are reached indirectly?
items.minimumData: Estimation model; source population; assumptions
items.answerRule: Label modelled reach; never add to verified reach without explanation

items.question: How many intended beneficiaries complete the intervention?
items.minimumData: Intake cohort; completion criteria; exit date
items.answerRule: Completion / eligible starters; record attrition reasons

items.question: What changed from baseline for participants?
items.minimumData: Indicator; person/cohort ID; baseline; endline; dates
items.answerRule: Paired change for comparable records; report missing matches

items.question: How many participants achieve a meaningful outcome?
items.minimumData: Outcome threshold defined in advance; observed result; eligible cohort
items.answerRule: Achievers / evaluated cohort; show evaluable coverage

items.question: Are improvements sustained after support ends?
items.minimumData: Follow-up window; repeat measure; contact attempts
items.answerRule: Outcome retention at stated follow-up intervals

items.question: How strong is the evidence for each impact claim?
items.minimumData: Source type; design; sample; validation; limitations
items.answerRule: Transparent evidence tier; no automatic causal score

items.question: Which results have been independently validated?
items.minimumData: Evaluator independence; scope; report; findings
items.answerRule: Assured claims versus internally verified claims

items.question: Which partnerships are active and delivering work?
items.minimumData: Partner ID; agreement; start/end; joint activity
items.answerRule: Active partnerships; separate dormant agreements

items.question: How do partners share decisions and resources?
items.minimumData: Governance; voting/approval rights; funding; work allocation
items.answerRule: Reciprocity and decision influence

items.question: What resources do external partners contribute?
items.minimumData: Cash; staff time; facilities; equipment; valuation basis
items.answerRule: Cash and in-kind separately; prevent double counting

items.question: What student learning follows community engagement?
items.minimumData: Reflection; civic/ethical/technical competencies; rubric
items.answerRule: Assessed learning change and supporting work

items.question: How was the initiative implemented?
items.minimumData: Timeline; milestones; decisions; partners; delivery methods
items.answerRule: Coherent implementation account linked to records

items.question: What measurable progress occurred in the eligible period?
items.minimumData: Baseline; outputs; outcomes; dates; verification
items.answerRule: Isolate award-period results from lifetime totals

items.question: What evidence demonstrates community ownership?
items.minimumData: Co-design; co-delivery; governance; partner endorsement
items.answerRule: Community role and independently expressed benefit

items.question: Can another institution replicate or scale the approach?
items.minimumData: Required resources; conditions; costs; limitations; adaptations
items.answerRule: Transferability assessment and actual replications

items.question: Can every reported value be traced to source records?
items.minimumData: Metric ID; source system; query; records; transformation version
items.answerRule: Complete lineage from source to submitted value

items.question: Does every claim have relevant dated evidence?
items.minimumData: Claim ID; evidence; period; page/section; verifier
items.answerRule: Supported claims / eligible claims; zero is not missing

items.question: Are repeated people, projects and outputs deduplicated?
items.minimumData: Stable IDs; match rules; aliases; duplicate log
items.answerRule: Deduplication within each aggregation scope

items.question: Are estimates clearly separated from measured values?
items.minimumData: Measurement method; estimation formula; assumptions; uncertainty
items.answerRule: Measured/estimated/self-reported classifications

items.question: Are personal and sensitive data appropriately protected?
items.minimumData: Access role; consent; purpose; retention; anonymization
items.answerRule: Publish aggregates; restricted evidence under controlled access
